t: You're at the Memorial to the Battle of Waterloo, inside Waterloo station. It was made by Jason Brooks, a British painter and sculptor born in 1968. Brooks came to attention among the Young British Artists in the 1990s with his black and white portraits, and he won the NatWest art prize in 1999. His work is held in public collections, including the National Portrait Gallery in London. Here, he has turned that skill to a memorial.
